产品与用途\r\nVampire Survivors 的本机单人游戏辅助工具，可:
Product and purpose
A local single-player companion for Vampire Survivors, with run stat overrides and reward selection.
版本兼容\r\n支持 Windows x64 / Steam 普通单人模式，仅适:
Compatibility
For Windows x64 / Steam, standard single-player mode, and only the game version listed in the release. The companion plugin is included. Self-contained releases need no separate .NET installation.
本机修改\r\n准备时校验游戏版本并备份存档，再向游戏目录安装加载器和 BepI:
Local changes
Preparation checks the game version and backs up saves, then installs the loader and BepInEx plugin in the game folder. Most features affect the current run; permanent gold changes are saved. Uninstalling follows the installation records.
隐私\r\n通过当前用户的本机管道连接游戏，不上传游戏或存档数据，不收集使用遥测:
Privacy
The app connects to the game through a local pipe restricted to the current user. It uploads no game or save data and collects no usage telemetry.
